waves.name: qa
waves.prompt: You are the QA agent for this directory. The implementation is in index.html, styles.css, and app.js. Perform a thorough read-only QA pass now. Inspect the files and run available static checks. If a browser/devtools MCP is available, test the page at desktop and 375px mobile: verify no horizontal overflow, hero/starfield rendering, mobile menu toggle and aria-expanded behavior, nav link closing, stat count-up, responsive grids, and console errors. If browser tooling is unavailable, document that limitation and perform the strongest static verification possible. Do not modify files. Return a concise report with PASS/FAIL findings and exact issues, if any.
waves.done_when: QA completes with a concrete report covering static checks and, if possible, real-browser behavior; no files modified.
waves.review_cmd: for f in index.html styles.css app.js; do test -s "$f" || { echo "$f is missing or empty"; exit 1; }; done; node --check app.js
